description: PROPOSAL ONLY — correlate Codex Explorer lifecycle candidate hooks with codex exec --json thread/turn envelope. Do not activate automatically.

required: all item events stay inside the turn boundary
hook/exec traces are absolute, regular, non-symlink files outside the repository
hook and exec raw trace SHA-256 are bound into the result

privacy_notes: Raw JSONL may contain agent messages, reasoning summaries, commands, tool arguments, and outputs; do not persist those fields into correlation results.
Persist only opaque ids, counts, booleans, and the raw trace content hash.
The raw traces stay in runner-temporary or another approved evidence store outside the repository.
trust_notes: A same-thread match is stronger than hook-only observation, but it is not exact turn or subagent identity correlation.
The public exec JSONL turn.started event currently has no turn id.
The public ThreadItem union currently has no subagent identity item.
A future stronger adapter needs an independently exposed runtime identifier before codex_jsonl_runtime_correlation_verified may become true.
Absence of file_change does not prove shell/MCP read-only behavior or repository cleanliness; those postconditions stay separately unverified.
Matching hook session_id to exec thread_id is a parent-thread correlation candidate, not proof that the same Explorer subagent produced the exec JSONL.
Unknown item types are recorded as schema drift and keep coverage incomplete; they are not promoted into a stable public contract.
